examples.title: Checking Symmetry by Folding
examples.problem: Does the letter 'A' have a line of symmetry?
examples.solution: Yes, a vertical line through the center.
examples.explanation: If you fold 'A' vertically, the left and right sides overlap perfectly.

examples.title: Square Symmetry
examples.problem: Draw all lines of symmetry for a square.
examples.explanation: A regular polygon like a square has lines of symmetry equal to its number of sides.

examples.title: Non-symmetrical Shapes
examples.problem: Why is the letter 'P' not symmetrical?
examples.solution: No matter where you draw a line, the two halves will never match.
examples.explanation: Shapes with no line of symmetry are called asymmetrical.
